transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’m having trouble getting my thoughts out straight. At work, when I try to explain inventory numbers or the weekend schedule, my words kind of jump around—from trucks, to Thursdays, to the church grill, to my boss’s tone—and people look at me like they can’t follow what I’m saying. It’s been worrying me.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual and still feeling full of energy?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed needing less sleep and feeling energized. My sleep might vary some, but I wouldn’t say I’m full of energy on less sleep.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t think I hear voices like a person talking in the room when nobody’s there. Nothing clear like that, at least.
Have you had a strong belief that other people would say is not true?
I’m not sure. I can’t think of a strong belief like that, where everyone else says it’s definitely not true. I’ve had worries about things, but nothing I’d describe that way.
Did this problem with your thoughts and speech start suddenly?
No, it wasn’t all at once. It’s been building up gradually, maybe about 11 months now. I noticed it more after the new district manager started pushing harder on the forecasts and schedules.
Have you had a period of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough days and felt down at times, but not most of the day nearly every day for two weeks straight, at least not that I’ve noticed.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve been talking much less overall. Maybe I keep to myself a bit sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a big change like that.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was unusually high or irritable?
Not really, no. I get irritated sometimes like anybody, especially with stress, but I can’t think of a period where my mood was unusually high or where I was irritable in a way that lasted.
Have other people told you that your behavior seems strange or hard to make sense of?

Yeah, a few times. At work especially, people have looked at me like they don’t know what I’m doing. I’ll catch myself pacing the same aisle on the sales floor, or straightening the same row of batteries over and over. Sometimes I’m just standing there holding the schedule clipboard while the associates are waiting for me to tell them what to do. They don’t always say it directly, but I can tell it seems strange to them.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still do the things I usually like when I have the time. Maybe I’m not as excited about some things lately, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest exactly.
Have you found it harder to feel emotions, like your face or voice seems less expressive than it used to?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed my face or voice being different. Nobody’s pointed it out to me either. I guess sometimes I feel a little flat when I’m tired, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean.
Have you felt that people were watching you or trying to harm you?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t felt like anyone was trying to hurt me. Sometimes I wonder if people are looking at me because I’m acting off, but I wouldn’t say I feel watched or threatened.
Have there been times when your thoughts felt jumbled or your behavior seemed strange even though your mood felt normal?

Yes, that’s actually part of why I came in. My mood can feel pretty normal, but when I’m trying to explain something at work, like inventory numbers or the weekend schedule, my words start jumping around. I’ll go from talking about the trucks to Thursdays to something about the church grill, then my boss’s tone, and people look at me like they can’t follow what I’m saying.
During the time these thinking and behavior problems have been happening, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I can’t say I’ve had a stretch like that, where I was depressed most of the day almost every day for two weeks. I’ve had bad days, but I don’t know that it was that consistent.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see, at least not that I’ve noticed.
Have you had a belief that other people said was definitely not true, even though you were convinced it was true?

I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had thoughts where other people disagreed with me or thought I was reading too much into something, but I can’t think of a belief like that where everyone said it was definitely false and I still knew it was true.
Have these problems with your thoughts and behavior been present for at least one month?
Yes. It’s been going on longer than a month. I’d say it’s been building for maybe 11 months now, since the new district manager started pushing harder on the forecasts and schedules.
Have you ever clearly heard a voice speaking to you when no one was there?
No, I can’t say that I have. I haven’t clearly heard a voice talking to me when nobody was there.
Have these problems been going on continuously for at least six months?
Yes, continuously, more or less. It’s been building for about 11 months now, since the new district manager started pushing harder on the forecasts and schedules.
Have you ever been completely convinced of something that other people said was not true?
I’m not sure. I mean, people have told me I’m wrong about things before, sure, but completely convinced of something that everyone else said wasn’t true… I don’t know that I’d put it that way.
